brief:
The Quincy Institute reports that Iran has developed a confidential strategic plan responding to Israel's recent election results. Details of the plan remain undisclosed, though the assessment suggests Tehran is preparing long-term positioning based on the composition of Israel's new government.

Iranian officials have historically adjusted foreign and defense policies following significant Israeli political shifts. The timing of such contingency planning typically reflects Tehran's broader concerns regarding potential shifts in Israeli-Palestinian tensions, nuclear negotiations, or regional security arrangements.
title: Iran plots strategic response to Israeli election outcome
